events.body: Return RTN-3832 authorised for TG-6539, both lines: kettle (line 1) and four-slice toaster (line 2), reason 'changed mind', inside the 30-day window. Return label team will issue one label for one carton. Refunds team refunds per line on the returns warehouse's receipt scan, not before.
Label issued for RTN-3832 and emailed to the customer. One carton, both items. Valid 14 days. Return shipment reference DL-2150.
got the label thanks. Dropping both off at the weekend.
Had a rethink. Forget the return, I'll keep them.

Sorry ignore that last one, typed it too fast. I mean I'm keeping the KETTLE (mum's has just died so she's having this one). Toaster is still going back, it's too wide for the shelf. So just the toaster in the box.
To check I have this right: you are keeping the kettle and returning only the toaster? Please don't hand the carton over until Gorsewick confirms the return has been changed to match.

Morning. Our portal log shows the customer opened and abandoned a 'cancel return' form on RTN-3832 last night. Nothing was submitted, so RTN-3832 stands as authorised, both lines. Tell us if anything needs changing; amendments have to reach us before the carton gets its first carrier scan.

For information on TG-6539: the refund is calculated on what the returns warehouse scans in against the authorised lines. A carton that does not match the authorisation goes to the manual discrepancy queue, typically 10 or more working days.
Yes. Kettle stays, toaster goes back. Was going to drop it at the parcel shop after work, about half 5. Will wait if I have to but is the same label ok?

Amendment needed on RTN-3832 (TG-6539) before the carton is scanned. The customer has confirmed in her order thread, twice, that she is keeping the kettle (line 1) and returning only the four-slice toaster (line 2). She is not cancelling the return; the abandoned cancel form last night was a first thought she corrected within half an hour. Please amend RTN-3832 to line 2 only and confirm, and tell me whether the label already issued for DL-2150 is still valid for a toaster-only carton or whether a new one is needed. She had planned to drop it off today at about 17:30 and is holding until she hears.
FYI only, no action needed from the desk: we have this in hand and will update the customer directly. Nothing further is required from you on this one.
